name: Bresegard bei Picher (Germany)
description: White field charged at the centre with the figure of the municipal arms of Bresegard bei Picher, a green tree with white leaves on a red mount.
history: The flag was designed by the Barsbüttel heraldist Hans-Frieder Kühne and approved by the Ministry of the Interior on 1 November 1999.

features.role: tree with white leaves on a red mount
